content_zh:
难上加难的是，系统向逆命阵营隐瞒了对方的规则，并设计了无数思维陷阱，引导邢烨向错误方向思考。
恶意，这是邢烨自进入这个世界后最深的感受。无论是女装，还是女装，抑或是女装，都令他毛骨悚然，不得不打起十二万分精神去对待。
将思路捋顺后，邢烨不由感叹道：“虽然在幸运值只有1%的阵营中，但我的运气是真的不错。”
年长女仆呆滞地望着他，规则已经苛刻到这个程度了，这人竟然还觉得自己运气好？
“第一个对手这么笨，几乎将规则全部泄露给我，实在是运气太好了。”邢烨摇摇头道，“这游戏恶意很深，不能总是期待对手犯错，下一个操纵者我要谨慎对待。”
年长女仆：“……”
他这是在说我笨吗？我笨吗？年长女仆疑惑地想着。
她觉得输人不输阵，挺起腰板问道：“就算你猜到规则又能怎样？没有我，你要怎么逃出庄园？你只是个女仆，打晕卢卡伯爵，他醒来后一定会杀了你的。”
邢烨没有回应她，而是起身走出门，没过一会儿抱着一具尸体进入房间，正是他进门前见到的那位被凌虐致死的女仆。
“一般情况下，你们会怎么处理这些尸体？”邢烨问道。
“扔进河水中，”年长女仆道，“这里的人很不注意卫生。”
嗯，中世纪确实如此，也因此瘟疫横行。
“也就是说，这具尸体你应该已经遵照卢卡伯爵的吩咐处理了，如果卧室中再出现尸体，应该是克莱尔的。”邢烨说道，“你刚才说，游戏中死亡不是真正死亡？”
“当然不是，死亡只会默认输掉扣50%积分而已。而且这个游戏的失败惩罚规则永远是只扣50%积分，积分多则扣得多，但积分少也不会扣光。”年长女仆迫于邢烨的气势，不由自主地将她知道的规则全部说出来。
不会死亡……那邢烁又是因何而死？邢烨想起灵堂中的弟弟，他现在已经百分之百确定，邢烁的死与游戏有关，可是现在……
情报不够，他需要继续进行游戏，才能获取更多的信息。
将女仆的尸体、昏迷的伯爵放在一起，又把年长女仆拽到门前。
安排好这一切后，邢烨从伯爵房中选出一件最大号的骑马装，脱下女仆装，勉强换上男装。
胸口紧绷绷的，布条压得胸十分疼，邢烨紧皱眉头，相当不舒服。
他用寝室的刀将自己长长的头发割断，模仿着伯爵的发型，弄成这个世界男性常见的发型，折腾了半天后，他举起镜子打算看看发型对不对，这一次，镜子中竟然映出了他的容貌。

“左侧再削短一些。”它还给出了评价！
邢烨依言削短了头发，好像是比方才好看一些，镜子的审美不错。
“你、你要干什么？”年长女仆惊恐地问道，她实在猜不到邢烨要做什么。
“最后一个问题，你可不可以自己认输？”邢烨问道。
“可、可以。”年长女仆结结巴巴地回答，“认输后就会离开游戏世界，身体默认进入死亡状态。”
“很好，”邢烨将刀抵在年长女仆的脖子上，“自己认输离开和被我杀死，选一个。”
“这有什么区别？”
“你说过游戏中死亡痛感与现实一致，而我也不愿意亲手杀人，虽然我知道这不是真正杀死人，不过我不喜欢这种体验。你左右也是要死的，痛与不痛，很好选吧？”邢烨面无表情地用刀蹭着年长女仆的脖子，“说实话，我是个热爱和平的人，连鸡都没杀过，真的不保证自己能将你一刀致命，万一没死，死之前还要受不少苦的。”
你真的热爱和平吗？你这表情看起来很熟练啊！年长女仆全身发抖，她也不过是刚刚加入游戏而已，没想到才第一个世界就遇到这么可怕的人！
正如邢烨所说，这很好选，左右都是输，为什么不选择一条轻松的路。
见邢烨没有解释的意思，年长女仆也不想再与他单独相处下去了。她点开手环，向另外两名队友发送了“小心”的信息后，点击了认输键。

content_en:
What makes it even more difficult is that the system concealed the opponent's rules from the fate-defying camp and designed countless thinking traps to guide Xing Ye to think in the wrong direction.
Malice, this is Xing Ye's deepest feeling since entering this world. Whether it was women's clothing, women's clothing, or women's clothing, it all made his hair stand on end, and he had to be alert to deal with it.
After smoothing his thoughts, Xing Ye couldn't help but sigh: "Although I am in a camp with only 1% luck, my luck is really good."
The older maid looked at him blankly. The rules were already so harsh. How could this person still think he was lucky?
"The first opponent was so stupid and leaked almost all the rules to me. It was really lucky." Xing Ye shook his head and said, "This game is very malicious. You can't always expect your opponent to make mistakes. I have to be careful with the next manipulator."
Elderly maid: "..."
Is he calling me stupid? Am I stupid? The older maid thought doubtfully.
She felt that no one would lose, so she straightened her back and asked: "What if you guessed the rules? How are you going to escape from the manor without me? You are just a maid. Knock out Count Luca. He will definitely kill you when he wakes up."
Xing Ye did not respond to her, but stood up and walked out. After a while, he entered the room carrying a corpse. It was the maid who was tortured to death he saw before entering the door.
"Under normal circumstances, how would you deal with these corpses?" Xing Ye asked.
"Throw it into the river," said the older maid. "People here don't pay attention to hygiene."
Well, that was certainly the case in the Middle Ages, and plague was rampant as a result.
"In other words, you should have disposed of this corpse according to Count Luca's instructions. If another corpse appears in the bedroom, it should be Claire's." Xing Ye said, "You just said that death in the game is not real death?"
"Of course not, death will only default to loss and deduct 50% of the points. And the failure penalty rule of this game is always to deduct only 50% of the points. If you have more points, you will deduct more points, but if you have less points, you will not deduct all them." The older maid was forced by Xing Ye's momentum and couldn't help but tell all the rules she knew.
Will not die... Then why did Xing Shuo die? Xing Ye thought of his younger brother in the mourning hall. He was now 100% sure that Xing Shuo's death was related to the game, but now...
The information is not enough, he needs to continue playing the game to get more information.
Putting the maid's body and the unconscious earl together, he dragged the older maid to the door.
After arranging all this, Xing Ye chose the largest riding outfit from the count's room, took off his maid uniform, and reluctantly put on men's clothing.
His chest was tight, and the cloth pressed against his chest was very painful. Xing Ye frowned, feeling quite uncomfortable.
He used the knife in his dormitory to cut off his long hair, imitating the earl's hairstyle, and made it into a common hairstyle for men in this world. After struggling for a long time, he raised the mirror to see if the hairstyle was right. This time, his appearance was actually reflected in the mirror.
"Shorten the left side." It also commented!
Xing Ye shortened his hair as he was told, and it seemed to look better than before. The aesthetics of the mirror were good.
"What are you going to do?" the older maid asked in horror. She really couldn't guess what Xing Ye was going to do.
"Last question, can you admit defeat?" Xing Ye asked.
"Yes, yes." The older maid stammered in reply, "When you admit defeat, you will leave the game world and your body will enter a state of death by default."
"Very good," Xing Ye put the knife against the older maid's neck, "Choose one of surrendering and leaving or being killed by me."
"What difference does it make?"
"You said that the pain of death in the game is consistent with reality, and I am not willing to kill people with my own hands. Although I know that this is not really killing people, I don't like this experience. You are also going to die. It hurts or not, it's a good choice, right?? Xing Ye rubbed the elder maid's neck with his knife expressionlessly, "To be honest, I am a peace-loving person. I have never even killed a chicken. I really can't guarantee that I can kill you with a knife. If you don't die, you will have to suffer a lot before you die." "
Do you really love peace? Your expression looks very skilled! The older maid was trembling all over. She had just joined the game. She didn't expect to meet such a terrifying person in her first world!
As Xing Ye said, this is a good choice. Both sides are losing, so why not choose an easy path.
Seeing that Xing Ye had no intention of explaining, the older maid didn't want to be alone with him anymore. She clicked on the bracelet, sent a "be careful" message to the other two teammates, and clicked the admit defeat button.
